---
title: "Getting started"
subtitle: "From zero to two cats on your desktop"
---

DeskPets runs on **Windows**. The easiest way is the installer on the [Download](/project/download.qmd) page: run it, then start DeskPets from the Start Menu. If you'd rather run it from source, use [pixi](https://pixi.sh), which sets up the right Python and libraries for you.

## Run it from source

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/Suyash-Naik/DeskPets.git
cd DeskPets
pixi run -e pets pets
```

The first run downloads the dependencies, which takes a minute. Then Layla and Chico appear on your desktop. Hover over them to see the stats card.

## Good to know

- **Move them** by dragging. They remember where you left them.
- **Control them** from the tray icon: show or hide, always-on-top, click-through, and a Pomodoro timer.
- **Click-through mode** makes the pets ignore your mouse. If you ever lose them, double-click the tray icon to bring them back and turn it off.
- **Quit** from the tray menu.

Next: see what each animation means on [Pets and states](pets-and-states.qmd). Command-line options such as `--demo` are under [Configuration](configuration.qmd#command-line-flags).
